description: Strongest (top 0.1%) when either player has three in a row on the bottom row with both end cells empty, especially columns 3-5 or 1-3 (an unstoppable double threat); a stone on an outer end kills it. Otherwise it fires weakly and diffusely: more often when the side to move is lost (every move lets the opponent win), but most firing positions show no clear tactical feature, and the response is left-right asymmetric.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.03-0.06 (e.g. shifts a few points between columns 2 and 3 in one position); in lost positions nothing changes.
notes: Hypotheses: any immediate win/must-block (F1 0.10); row-0 open three or endgame with >=5 full columns (0.15); mover lost within 2 plies (0.22, P 0.27); final = lost-in-2 OR row-0 open three OR my double immediate win (F1 0.224, P 0.25, R 0.21, AUROC 0.59, sim share 0.01). One score call was wasted on an accidental rerun. Minimal pairs confirm the row-0 open-three mode (blocking an end drops it from ~2.9 to about -1); 2-4 open three is weaker (1.2). Most firing is unexplained and mirror-asymmetric; it may be a mixture or a random direction. Synthesis max 5.96 (non-terminal), below dev max 6.66.
